interpretations.excellent: Excellent level of rationality. You demonstrate strong critical thinking skills across most dimensions. You are able to resist common cognitive biases and reason rigorously.
interpretations.good: Good level of rationality. You have solid reasoning skills but there is room for improvement in certain areas. Some cognitive biases still influence your judgments.
interpretations.average: Average level of rationality. You have significant room for improvement. Several cognitive biases regularly affect your reasoning.
interpretations.belowAverage: Below average rationality level. You have difficulty resisting cognitive biases. Significant work is needed to improve your critical thinking.
interpretations.weak: Weak rationality level. You are very vulnerable to cognitive biases and reasoning errors. Your critical thinking requires substantial development.

nextStepsContent.item1: Consult your detailed results with complete scientific explanations
nextStepsContent.item2: Explore the recommended resources for each dimension
nextStepsContent.item3: Retake the test in 6-12 months to measure your real progress (not before, to avoid the memorization effect)

moduleDescriptions.Raisonnement Probabiliste: Your ability to reason with probabilities and avoid classic errors (gambler's fallacy, base rate neglect, conjunction error).
moduleDescriptions.Raisonnement Scientifique: Your ability to rigorously test hypotheses, falsify rather than confirm, and distinguish correlation from causation.
moduleDescriptions.Réflexion vs Intuition: Your ability to inhibit the immediate intuitive response and engage analytical reflection (CRT).
moduleDescriptions.Biais de Croyance: Your ability to evaluate logical validity independently of your beliefs about the conclusion.
moduleDescriptions.Calibration des Connaissances: Your ability to accurately estimate your level of certainty (avoid overconfidence).
moduleDescriptions.Numératie Probabiliste: Your ability to manipulate numbers in probabilistic contexts and understand statistics.
moduleDescriptions.Pensée Superstitieuse: Your resistance to paranormal/supernatural beliefs and respect for the principle 'belief proportional to evidence'.
moduleDescriptions.Attitudes Anti-Science: Your resistance to rejecting science and the scientific method.
moduleDescriptions.Croyances Conspirationnistes: Your resistance to conspiracy explanations and ability to apply Occam's Razor.
moduleDescriptions.Raisonnement Disjonctif: Your ability to reason correctly with 'OR' statements.
moduleDescriptions.Ancrage: Your resistance to anchoring (being too influenced by the first piece of information received).
moduleDescriptions.Croyances Dysfonctionnelles: Your ability to avoid irrational beliefs that cause unnecessary emotional distress.
